issue.title: Repair the release watcher and check-mode recapture, then ship sase v0.18.0
issue.description: The defects that the sase-1lh landing review found in its own watcher, check-mode recapture, and docs_split work are fixed. The watcher treats a stale release-PR head as something to refresh, not as CORE_FLOOR_BLOCKED. A fresh release watch sees sase 0.18.0 install from PyPI. This epic's land agent confirms the release, then resumes the interrupted sase-1lh landing through parent_bead.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/sase_1lh_landing_repair.md requests this work

issue.title: Refresh stale release-PR heads instead of declaring CORE_FLOOR_BLOCKED
issue.description: watcher-repair: make tools/release_watch tell a stale release-PR head from a real core-floor block, refresh the stale head through one Publish dispatch per master HEAD, and fix the dispatch red-budget and close-during-signal gaps.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/sase_1lh_landing_repair.md defines phase watcher-repair as one work unit

issue.title: Make check-mode recapture report failures honestly and fit the job budget
issue.description: recapture-repair: keep test failures and incomplete runs out of the recapture pass path, bound retries by the job's time budget, and clear any visual node that still fails at HEAD in Full CI.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/sase_1lh_landing_repair.md defines phase recapture-repair as one work unit

issue.title: Fix nested drop pointers that resolve anchor_target through the source anchor map
issue.description: docs-split-anchor: stop tools/docs_split from rewriting a dropped nested section's explicit anchor_target through the source page's anchor map, and pin it with a regression test.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/sase_1lh_landing_repair.md defines phase docs-split-anchor as one work unit

issue.title: Watch v0.18.0 to PyPI without editing files
issue.description: release-watch: make no edits, preflight the repaired watcher, monitor it until a verdict, and always close with an honest verdict.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/sase_1lh_landing_repair.md defines phase release-watch as one work unit
